candidates.evidence: Single dominant band at 197.12 cm-1 is in the low-frequency range where bulk 1T layered dichalcogenides typically show an Eg-type mode, but the strong A1g band that usually sits near 250 cm-1 is absent in 60-1100 cm-1. The HfSe2 mode values were not verified against a fetched source (the Valency search returned HfS2 and HfSe2 pressure papers without mode numbers in the abstracts), so this is weak and mostly inferred from memory.

hint_reasoning: No material hint was given (material_hint null), so there is no stated material to verify. The filename mentions HfSe2, but the task is to identify, and the file name is not a measurement fact. The spectrum has only one clear sample band (197.12 cm-1) plus the Si substrate line, which cannot fingerprint a material by itself. Identity is therefore not determined.

peaks.assignment: unassigned sample mode (strongest sample band, pseudo-Voigt fit, Lorentzian fraction 1.0, centre error 0.04 cm-1)
peaks.source: Fit of 180-215 cm-1 window in ./fit_check.py; centre +/- 0.04 cm-1, amplitude 10323 counts above linear baseline; no polarization series so no pattern class

citations: [arXiv:2212.05924](https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.05924): bulk HfS2 Raman paper; reports A1g and Eg modes and a 134 cm-1 mode and an approx. 184 cm-1 mode Z. Used only as context for layered hafnium dichalcogenide mode structure, not for numbers, since HfSe2 values were not available.
[doi:10.1021/acs.inorgchem.0c03223](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.inorgchem.0c03223): 1T-HfSe2 pressure study with Raman and DFT; the abstract gives no mode positions. Listed for context only.
limits: One unpolarized spectrum at one temperature (295 K). No angle series, so symmetry (A1g vs Eg) and polarization class cannot be assigned.
Spectral coverage is 60.4-1099.9 cm-1 with 0.94 cm-1 step. Modes above 1100 cm-1, and below 60 cm-1, were not measured, so the absence of any band there cannot be assessed.

Noise is large: residual sigma about 220 counts against a background of about 3000 counts. Residual search after removing the two fitted lines found nothing above about 4.7 sigma apart from a marginal band at 149.5 cm-1 (smoothed SNR 4.7 at 1 cm-1 width). It is not reported as a peak and needs a second measurement to confirm.

The 197.12 cm-1 band is the only sample feature; one band cannot identify a material. Several layered compounds could show a single dominant low-frequency band. HfSe2 is not confirmed or excluded because the reference mode positions were not verified from a fetched source.

The skill's reference library and matching scripts sit in a folder outside the working directory, and I was instructed not to read files outside this folder. So I did not run match_library or lookup_reference_modes, and no ranking against the Computational Raman Database or curated tables was done. Candidate ranking is therefore not supported by the reference match.
The 521.12 cm-1 line is consistent with the Si substrate; its +0.4 cm-1 offset relative to 520.7 cm-1 is within typical calibration error for a single unreferenced spectrum but is not corrected here.
Scripts written for this analysis, fit_check.py and residual_check.py, are in the data folder.
